paragraphs: I'm a fourth-year student at Far Eastern University - Alabang, taking a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology with a specialization in web and mobile applications. I build full-stack web apps and design their UI/UX, from the interface people use to the backend behind it and the deployment that keeps it live.

I focus on web development, UI/UX design and system design, and I'm still learning machine learning. Most of what I know comes from building real projects: the web platform for my capstone, Roblox gameplay systems, Java plugins for a Minecraft server, and a trip planner I'm building on my own.
